sources.use: Manufacturer guide: hidden contact clips, independent terminal strips and rails, split-rail caveat; read through web.
Manufacturer four/five-band definitions, digits, multipliers and tolerance; PDF text read through web.
Reference LED package cathode, flat base and unequal lead lengths; page 1 downloaded/rendered and visually inspected.

Reference four-terminal B3F topology and top/bottom view qualification; page 4 downloaded/rendered and visually inspected. Horizontal pairs 4/3 and 2/1 permanent in reference top view. Local A/B labels avoid pretending kit part pin numbers are known.
Pico 2 mechanical layout and 2.54 mm header pitch; official PDF read through web. Placement SVG is explicitly abbreviated, not a pin-count guide.

scope_audit.hidden_strips: Five holes per half-row explicitly one node; adjacent rows separate, gap isolates halves; same-node bypass failures explained.
scope_audit.rails: Potential mid-rail splits, independent rails, labels not voltage sources, optional unpowered continuity check; no rail continuity assumed.
scope_audit.pico: USB-up component-side top view, length follows gap; headers on opposite fields, each header pin separate row; exposed nodes accessible. Abbreviated placement drawing has correct seven-pitch row separation (c/h on standard geometry).
scope_audit.resistors: 1k and 4.7k values, four/five-band codes, tolerance, bag/meter ambiguity advice, non-polarity, roles.
scope_audit.led: Long anode/short cathode for uncut form, flat cathode inset, clipped-lead caveat and no assumption of actual LED manufacturer.
scope_audit.switch: Permanent A1/A2 and B1/B2 pairs, pressing joins groups, diagram places distinct groups on separate breadboard rows across gap; warns across-gap selection can still be permanently connected.
scope_audit.jumpers: Male/male, female/male, female/female, breadboard versus board-header fit and colour independence.
scope_audit.actual_kit: Explicitly unconfirmed ELEGOO revision, quantities, component identity. No invented box inventory. Optional meter does not become a prerequisite.
scope_audit.continuity: Builds on 0.4 and leaves bench unpowered for 0.6; no firmware or circuit energized.
